title: What's Bad About Julia | Jeff Bezanson | JuliaCon 2019
summary: Julia co-creator Jeff Bezanson candidly lists fundamental problems with the language at JuliaCon 2019, including modularity, types and compiler latency, and how they might be solved.
why: HN cites it as the language creator's honest account of Julia's weaknesses, useful for anyone evaluating the language.
